title: Mewgenics
genre: Turn-based tactics roguelike + cat-breeding / genetics life-sim (meta-progression via bred cat lineages)
release_date: 2026-02-10 (Steam, PC) [UNVERIFIED – prior knowledge, not re-checked this session; consistent with '1M in ~1 week' reported on 2026-02-17 by Game Informer/PC Gamer]
developer: Edmund McMillen & Tyler Glaiel (credited as a duo; no separate studio brand found in this session's searches)
team_size: 2 core developers (McMillen – design/art/writing; Glaiel – programming/design) [CONFIRMED – press: PC Gamer, Game Developer] + 'some handpicked devs from their community' as contributors [ESTIMATE/commentary – Rhys Elliott (Alinea) on X]; exact headcount: no data
developer_background: Edmund McMillen: co-creator of Super Meat Boy (Team Meat, 2010), creator of The Binding of Isaac (2011, Rebirth 2014), The End Is Nigh (2017, with Glaiel), The Legend of Bum-bo (2019). Tyler Glaiel: Closure (2012), co-developer/programmer of The End Is Nigh. Mewgenics was first announced by Team Meat around 2012, shelved, then McMillen took the IP back (~2018) and restarted it with Glaiel. [UNVERIFIED – prior knowledge; well-documented history but not re-checked this session because the shared web-search budget ran out]
publisher: self-published by the developers [UNVERIFIED – prior knowledge; no publisher mentioned in any press found this session]
platforms_and_store_links: Steam (PC) only at launch [CONFIRMED – Game Developer/press: 1M copies 'only on Steam']: https://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=Mewgenics ; console ports: no data
price_usd: ~$29.99 ('the game costs $30' – GameSpot/Alinea commentary) [CONFIRMED-ish – press report of store price]
units_or_downloads: 150,000+ copies within ~6 hours of launch (AllKeyShop report); 250,000 in under 12 hours; 500,000 in ~36 hours; 1,000,000 in ~7 days (by ~2026-02-17) [CONFIRMED – Tyler Glaiel social posts, via PC Gamer, Game Informer, Game Developer, Rogueliker]. Alinea Analytics also estimated ~1M at the same time [ESTIMATE]. Current (Oct 2026) total: no data – the shared WebSearch budget was exhausted before a later milestone or review count could be found; it is certainly well above 1M.
peak_concurrent_players: no data (not found before search budget ran out). Brief lead: 'at times higher concurrent players than Hades II' – unverified.
steam_reviews: no data (not retrieved – search budget exhausted)
gross_revenue: ~$22.5M by ~2026-02-17 (first week only) [ESTIMATE – 1M confirmed units × $22.49 avg realised price ($29.99 × 0.75)]; Alinea Analytics: 'close to $25M' gross at 1M [ESTIMATE – Rhys Elliott via GameSpot]. Lifetime gross to Oct 2026 is higher but unknown.
net_revenue: ~$15.2M on first-week sales [ESTIMATE – $22.5M gross; Steam 30% on first $10M + 25% on next $12.5M; × 0.93 refunds]; self-published, so no publisher split (if self-publishing is correct). Lifetime: no data.
production_cost: ~$1.0M–$1.5M [ESTIMATE – 2 core devs × ~84 months (2018/19–2026) × $6k/mo ≈ $1.0M plus community contractors/music/QA]. Cross-check: Glaiel said the game recouped its development costs within ~3 hours of launch [CONFIRMED – via PC Gamer/Rogueliker]; AllKeyShop's own (unofficial) budget estimate ~$1.4M recouped by 150k copies in 6 hours [ESTIMATE].
development_time: ~7 years for the current version (restart with Glaiel ~2018/19 → Feb 2026); ~14 years from first announcement (~2012, Team Meat era) [UNVERIFIED – prior knowledge]
why_popular: McMillen's huge Binding of Isaac/Super Meat Boy fanbase and a decade of 'will it ever come out' anticipation; very deep replayable tactics roguelike plus breeding/genetics that creates personal, emergent stories about your cats; gross-out humour and grotesque-cute cats that are highly shareable; strong reviews before launch converted wishlists (~400k before reviews → ~600k at launch) [CONFIRMED – Glaiel via PC Gamer]. First-week sales far exceeded wishlist-based expectations ('we both got a bit blindsided').
marketing_channels: Creator fame + existing community (Isaac fans, Reddit, Discord); long-running wishlist build on Steam; review embargo lift before launch boosting wishlists by ~50%; streamers/YouTubers (roguelike & Isaac creators); social posts by the devs during launch (milestones went viral in press); Steam front-page/top-seller momentum.
engine: custom C++ engine/tools by Tyler Glaiel [UNVERIFIED – prior knowledge; not confirmed this session]
art_style: Edmund McMillen's hand-drawn 2D cartoon style – grotesque-cute, gross-out humour, flat colours, puppet-style 2D animation.
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: code a grid-based tactics combat system, roguelike run structure, breeding/inheritance data model and save system; generate placeholder 2D art and many ability icons; draft ability/item text; SFX and music. AI cannot: the depth of design (hundreds of interacting abilities, mutations, classes and genetics that stay balanced), McMillen's distinctive art voice and humour, years of playtest-driven balancing, and a pre-existing million-fan audience. Something 'similar in spirit' (small tactics roguelike with breeding meta) is doable solo, but matching Mewgenics' content and depth is a multi-year job. | Toolset: Claude Code + Godot 4 (or Unity) + GodotSteam/Steamworks.NET, Retro Diffusion/Scenario/Midjourney for 2D concept and sprites (heavy manual clean-up), Spine or Godot skeletal 2D animation, ElevenLabs SFX, Suno/Udio music, spreadsheet-driven balance data.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: 8–12 weeks, ~$500–$1,500 (Claude Max $100–$200/mo, image gen $30–$60/mo, audio ~$30/mo, Steam Direct $100). Excludes developer living costs.
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: 12–24 months, ~$8,000–$30,000 (tools ~$300/mo, freelance 2D art/animation for a coherent style $3k–$15k, music $1k–$5k, playtests/marketing $1k–$5k). Excludes developer living costs.

Launch pace: AllKeyShop says 150k in 6 hours, Glaiel says 250k in <12h – compatible. Gross at 1M: Alinea ~$25M vs this spec's method ~$22.5M (Alinea likely assumes less regional discounting). AllKeyShop's ~$1.4M budget is its own estimate, not a developer figure. Peak CCU, reviews and post-Feb-2026 sales: not found.
notes: Needs a follow-up pass: Steam review count/%, SteamDB all-time peak CCU, any later sales milestone (2M+?), confirmation of engine and studio/publisher name. Lesson for solo creators: a decade of brand-building is not replicable, but the mechanic (breeding/inheritance feeding a roguelike) is a strong 'emergent story' hook; review-embargo timing before launch converted ~200k extra wishlists.
